players.bio: Alan Ernesto Bautista Gutiérrez (born 11 June 2002) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Pachuca.
Norman Andrés Micolta Arroyo (born 6 July 1999) is an Ecuadorian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Liga MX club Pachuca.
Carlos Agustín Moreno Luna (born 29 January 1998) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Liga MX club Pachuca.
Eduardo Gabriel dos Santos Bauermann (born 13 February 1996), known as Eduardo Bauermann, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Liga MX club Pachuca.
Elías Enrique Montiel Ávalos (born 7 October 2005) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Liga MX club Pachuca.
Gustavo Daniel Cabral (born 14 October 1985) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays for Mexican club C.F. Pachuca as a central defender.
Javier Eduardo López Ramírez (born 17 September 1994), also known as "Chofis", is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Liga MX club Pachuca.
Jorge Ernesto Berlanga Vázquez (born 18 July 2003) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a defender for Pachuca.

Robert Kenedy Nunes do Nascimento (born 8 February 1996), known as Kenedy, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Liga MX club Pachuca, on loan from Real Valladolid. Kenedy made his professional debut aged 17 for Fluminense, scoring five goals in 40 official games before a £6.3 million move to Chelsea in 2015.
Luis Alfonso Rodríguez Alanís (born 21 January 1991), commonly known as "Chaka Rodríguez", is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Liga MX club Pachuca.

Mauricio André Isaís (born 9 April 2001) is a Mexican-American professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Liga MX club Toluca. Early life Born in Brownwood, Texas to Mexican parents, in 2001, Isaís' family relocated to the Mexican town of San Francisco del Rincon in the state of Guanajuato, near the city of León. It was there that Isaís began to develop a love for the sport.

Oussama Idrissi (Arabic: أسامة ادريسي; born 26 February 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Liga MX club Pachuca. Born in the Netherlands, he represented Morocco at international level.
Rodolfo Gilbert Pizarro Thomas (born 15 February 1994) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Greek Super League club AEK Athens.

José Salomón Rondón Giménez (Spanish pronunciation: ; born 16 September 1989) is a Venezuelan professional footballer who plays as a striker for Liga MX club Pachuca, and captains the Venezuela national team.

William Silva de Carvalho ComM (born 7 April 1992) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Liga MX club Pachuca. He spent most of his career with Sporting CP since making his debut with the first team at the age of 18, going on to appear in 192 competitive games and win the 2015 Portuguese Cup.
